text: In response to the above issues, this thesis designs and implements a cloud native data analysis platform based on a workflow engine. This platform provides capabilities such as data storage, data analysis, task scheduling, model training, resource scheduling, platform resource monitoring and platform anomaly warning. On the one hand, the platform provides the necessary resources for various data analysis tasks and ensures their efficient and stable operation. On the other hand, it arranges and schedules various data analysis tasks through a workflow engine to improve operational efficiency. In order to ensure the stable operation of the platform, this thesis proposes a Multivariate Time Series Data Anomaly Detection Algorithm based on Dynamic Graph and Data Sequence Fusion (DGDSF-AD), which is based on the fusion of dynamic graphs and data sequences. The algorithm aims to effectively detect abnormal patterns in the time and space of platform indicator data. The core method is to model the short-term and long-term static relationships between time series based on a series of pre built dynamic graphs, thereby assisting both graph prediction and time series prediction tasks. Ultimately, the graph prediction task is coupled with the time series prediction task, and anomalies are identified based on their combined prediction errors. Combining the error scores of the two tasks can compensate for each other's shortcomings and jointly improve the performance of anomaly detection. Through a series of experiments, it has been verified that the method proposed in this thesis has better ability to capture temporal and spatial anomalies, resulting in higher accuracy in anomaly detection than algorithms such as MTAD-GAN, GDN, and DyGraphAD. This algorithm has been applied in the operation and maintenance subsystem of the data analysis platform designed and implemented in this thesis, and has achieved good application results.
